summary: Server singleton of esv::screen_fade::ScreenFadeSystem: per screen-fade id (Guid), the game time at which the fade times out. FinalizeComponents inserts 'current time + 30' for every fade-to request it registers (and logs 'Trying to finish a FadeTo for a ScreenFade that doesn't exist' otherwise). Sibling of ScreenFadeIdToFadeNameComponent (HashMap<Guid, ScreenFadeNameData>). Seen.py context: singleton present in the idle level and act1-idle; samples held 1 entry.
